events.title: HackTech 2026: Inter-College Hackathon
events.tagline: 36 Hours of Collaborative Engineering & Rapid Prototyping
events.description: HackTech 2026 is our flagship inter-college hackathon bringing together over 300 passionate student developers, designers, and innovators. Tackle real challenges in AI Systems, Clean Energy, Healthcare Tech, and Open Finance. Mentorship from top engineers, fully sponsored food and accommodation, and huge industry recognition.
events.transportParkingNotes: Visitor parking is accessible via Gate 3. Free shuttle from Metro Station every 15 mins.
events.rulesAndGuidelines:
1. All code must be written during the hackathon.
2. Pre-existing open source libraries are permitted.
3. Every team must present a working demo in Round 2.
4. Professional code of conduct is strictly enforced.

rounds.name: Round 2: Live Prototype Demonstration & Pitch
